title: Bicycle distance counter
prompt: A labelled teaching cutaway of the page 38 bicycle distance counter is mounted at a small front wheel with a peg on one spoke. Roll advances the driving gear one tooth per wheel revolution, with reduction gearing accumulating distance on numbered drums. Run farther continues the calibrated count until a drum rolls from 9 to 0 and its carry wheel advances the next drum by one numeral. Slow view slows only the explanation. See-through exposes the spoke peg, driving gear, reduction train, drum teeth, gaps and projections, and the alternating wide and narrow carry teeth. Do not add a trip-reset mechanism. Any scene reset restores the demonstration state without claiming counter hardware.
blurb: An enlarged teaching adaptation turns wheel revolutions into cumulative distance and exposes the decimal carry between numbered drums.

limits: Enlarged counter, illustrative case and reduction tooth counts.
Polygonal teeth represent pitch-correct gearing, not manufacturing profiles.
Slow view changes playback only. No trip-reset mechanism.
1988 inaccessible and unverified. No verified edition-union claim.

provenance.2016: Direct printed page 38 image and saved primary OCR inspected.

telemetry: No production telemetry installed. Local verification only.
